# Extra apt packages the ubuntu CI runner installs before configuring the build.
# One package per line; '#' comments allowed. Read by .github/workflows/ci.yml.
# Qt 6 Widgets (ADR-0001) + the GL headers its widgets module links against.
qt6-base-dev
libgl1-mesa-dev
pkg-config
libzip-dev
libpugixml-dev
# fonts-dejavu-core: the renderer tests paint real text; the headless CI runner
# ships no fonts otherwise, so text would render empty and the pixel checks fail.
fonts-dejavu-core
